title.tr: Üstten bakışla geniş basamaklı korkuluklu merdiven
title.en: Wide-tread stairs with railing seen from above

alt.tr: Üstten görünen geniş basamaklı ahşap merdiven; çıtalı korkuluk ve yanda telli çit
alt.en: Wide-tread timber stairs seen from above, with a slatted railing and wire fencing at the side

caption.tr: Geniş basamaklar yukarıdan düzgün sıralanmış görünüyor. Korkuluk ince çıtalardan, yanda tel çit var.
caption.en: Seen from above, the wide treads line up neatly. The railing is made of thin slats and wire fencing runs alongside.
